steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: He's not sending any men after the other clans. He's just guarding the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Right, he's guarding the Vine-Bead Court.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Now he's truly seized the Court.

options: History is written by the victor.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: *Sigh*... You're right about that.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Even I understand the way Enciodes does things now.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Him handing back power is all a feint. He wanted to flip the whole table over all along.

options: The people of Kjerag still can't imagine life without their God.
Enciodes knows what life is like without God.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Right. Most of us thought he had no way to overcome the Kjerag people's faith for Kjeragandr. They thought he didn't have what it takes.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The Great Elder, Ratatos, Arctosz... even I thought so.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: And he knew that.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: That said, I've been wondering about one thing.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: A life without God. Does that necessarily mean there should be no gods?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Oh, I'm just musing. I'm not depressed at all.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Faith is gradually becoming an obstacle... At the very least, that's how the Kjerag people's faith in Kjeragandr is. I've known that for a long time now.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Thank you, though.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: *Sigh*... Not that this has anything to do with me, a lowly maid who serves the Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Speaking of which, I thought you'd ask me why I'm here with you.

options: There are many reasons to choose to be an observer.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Just like you have many reasons to choose to interfere, right?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I will stand firm with my choice, and I hope you will too.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor, the work is done.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I couldn't keep the clan leaders. Ratatos asked me to give you her thanks, but it looks like she's got her own plans. She went back to her territory.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Arctosz's heading back to his place, too. Looks like he's gathering his forces to fight it out with Enciodes.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Doctor, if we let them go back to their lands, won't that lead inevitably to death?

options: Only they can control their people.
With the way things are, this is how we can keep casualties to a minimum.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: What the Doctor's saying is that, with how furious the crowd was, they would most likely have gotten a death sentence right there and then if the two of them were caught.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: And even if that wasn't the case, they would still no doubt stand trial.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: The two of them may be labeled traitors, but the two families' subordinates, especially the Paleroches, won't buy that so easily.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: And regardless of whether they take up arms or start infighting, Kjerag will fall into chaos.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But whichever it is, Enciodes will be the righteous one.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: To him, even if things start out chaotic and there are considerable casualties during the process, the whole mess can be still be cleaned up in the end.

options: He's not the kind of man who'll just sit it out.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Right, Enciodes went through all that trouble to shape this situation. That means he cares about the masses.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: When I bummed around Karlan Trade, I heard a thing or two about his methods. Most of the staff there thinks he's got foresight.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: And now that he chose to stir the pot out in the open like that? You can tell it's his best option despite all the risks it comes with.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: I... I sure hope so.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The Silverashes and the Browntails were on better terms in the past. Naturally, he's planted more than a few of his pawns who can help control the chaos.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The problem is still the Paleroches. Their equipment and combat prowess may be behind the times, but their numbers are no joke.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Right, and the Silverashes have always been on pretty bad terms with them.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Besides, the Paleroches' men are all very loyal. It's hard to say they'll betray the Paleroche clan even with everything that has transpired.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: That's why I can understand why the Doctor decided to help the two of them.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: A family can only come together if the family head's still alive, and as long as we can influence the leaders in some way, the Doctor can still pull off some rough plan.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Still though, Doctor, I guess I don't have to say it—

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Kjerag's got some complex terrain. It's not easy to get around here. We don't have much time.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Sorry for the wait, Matriarch.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sorry that you have to help me now, of all times.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Don't mention it. I am a Browntail. This is exactly the time I should stand with my Matriarch.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Do you believe anything Enciodes said?

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Of course not. He has to be framing you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: How go the preparations?

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: It'll take some time to get back to the Browntail territory from Silverash lands, though I have a car ready, and I pulled a few strings.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Once you and Madame Sciurus are ready, I will make sure you two are taken back to the our land.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Any news from back home?

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: After word about the ceremony got out, a few towns near our territory's border started flying the Silverashes' flag.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: There's nothing like that toward the center, but...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enough. I have a decent idea of how many men he planted inside our family. With how many of them there are, I'm afraid I won't be able to count all of them when they're all gathered in one spot.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Has Enciodes been up to anything?

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: The Silverashes have set up camp at the foot of Mount Karlan and on the mountainside.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph, at least he's a man of his word.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: The populace there has been very receptive to him too. Absolutely shameless.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: They saw Arctosz's betrayal at the ceremony with their own eyes, after all.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hmph, out of everyone who doesn't trust Arctosz, it's gotta be those who saw his 'crimes' with their own eyes that don't trust him the most.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let's not talk about him. What about you? What are you getting from Enciodes?

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: I... I don't follow...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Drop it already. Your acting's terrible.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Come on out and... Arrest Ratatos.

steps.name: Browntail Family Noble
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If I couldn't see through that trap of yours, then I had no business leading our clan.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos, I heard the car's...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What's going on here?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Take a guess?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He was going to sell us out?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Looks like you're not as stupid as I made you out to be, dear sister.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Do you have to mock me, even at a time like this?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How many are still on our side?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: How many? Right, how many...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus, do you understand what a big mess you've caused?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I never thought...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *Sigh*... That's exactly the problem. You never thought. You never think.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What was I supposed to do?! I... I just wanted to show everyone that I can do something for the Browntails too!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I just...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I just wanted to help you...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You... You look tired, Ratatos. Are you okay?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And if I say I'm not?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Fine, I get it! This whole thing needs to end somehow, right?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I was the one who started all this. So I'll be the one to end it! And I still don't know how Yucatan and... and my subordinate are doing. I can't just sit here and wait any longer!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Wait! Where are you going?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll find that prick Enciodes! I'll tell everyone that it was all a personal grudge between me and him, and none of this has anything to do with the Browntails!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He can take my life if he wants, but he has to hand my people back!
Sis, Sis! Why did Grandpa yell at you again? You've done so well!
Is it because you're going to lead the family? Is that why he keeps yelling at you?
I-In that case, I'll be the clan leader! I'll go to Grandpa and ask him to stop yelling at you all the time. I'll lead the family, so he can yell at me all he wants!
Hehe, it's okay. You don't need to worry about me, Sis. I've got Yucatan there for me. We promised each other we'll always play with each other! He'll help me. He's really good at studying too!
Also...
You never cry when you get yelled at, Sis.
Even though you never cry, I don't know why, it really makes my heart ache...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Ha, haha...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What's with you?! You stinking bitch! You can laugh at me, even at a time like this?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Hahaha... *Sigh*... Haha...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: (Rus... my silly sister...)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're probably cursing at me in your head again, aren't you?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Something like that.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Grrr!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *Sigh*, come back. Don't go looking for Enciodes. You should stay out of this... Things aren't as simple as you think.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus, do you remember we last had a nice chat together?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I don't remember the two of us having a nice chat ever.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I guess not...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright, I need to think about what to do from here on out. You should go back to whatever it is you do.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Oh, and be careful on your way home. Don't get caught.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What do you mean? You aren't heading back to our land?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz most likely hasn't gotten back to his estate yet.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Once he's settled down some, he'll probably go out and pick a fight with Enciodes.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I've got to do something before that happens.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Don't you do anything stupid. Don't forget. Enciodes got Yucatan and Monch!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And you... If anything happens to you, I'm gonna be running the show back home! D-Don't you forget that!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus could end up running the show back home, huh...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That might not be so bad...

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner A
steps.text: Look, it's Sir Arctosz's team...

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner B
steps.text: I heard he poisoned the Great Elder during the ceremony...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Shut up, all of you! Think about it. Would he possibly do anything as underhanded as poisoning someone?

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner A
steps.text: Well... no... but...

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: You're a Paleroche, and you don't trust him?!

steps.name: Paleroche Commoner A
steps.text: Eeeek!!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough, Gulo.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Taking it out on the common folk. Have you no shame?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But, Sir...!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: It doesn't matter if we were framed by Enciodes. What's done is done. Saying anything isn't going to help our case.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But do we really have to swallow our pride and take it?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Swallow our pride? Of course not!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'll hand it to him. He's good, but do you know what's the biggest mistake he made?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He didn't kill me at the ceremony.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: As soon as we get back to the estate and have our forces gathered, we'll head back to finish the fight with him.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We'll show Enciodes just what a big mistake he made.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Very well! I should've expected no less from you, sir!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I won't give you this chance.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Valais?!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Those men behind you... Are you betraying the Paleroches?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais... The house of Paleroche has treated you well. Why are you doing this?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You've treated me well...?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: You still don't remember even now, do you?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Remember what? I, Arctosz, am an honorable man. When have I ever—

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: This is, um?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't be afraid, Valais.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Your father will get much better once he takes the Great Elder's elixir and has the evil in him expelled.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He was injured during the Holy Hunt to protect us.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The Great Elder figured he was probably attacked by the Tschäggättä when he was all alone...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He's too weak now... Come, I'll give him the medicine.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Why isn't my father awake yet? And what is this green stuff on his lips...?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The evil has spread too deep. Kjeragandr no longer allows his presence here.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: He argued with the Vine-Bead Court several times before. He must have been under the Tschäggättä's influence, and it culminated in the Tschäggättä coming to take him back today.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: If the elixir couldn't regain his strength and faith, then this must be Her will.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The wine the Great Elder drank. It can't be!

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Do you remember the bottle of elixir that the Great Elder brought with him when he visited my father? How it was nowhere to be found?

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I'm sorry, my master. I had my doubts, and I didn't fully believe it either... until the moment the Great Elder collapsed during the ceremony.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I... I sent my own officer to... with my own hands...

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: I don't blame you. It wasn't your fault.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: But perhaps it's high time that Kjerag saw change for the better. I hope you won't stand in my way.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Please think of it as a way to avoid having even more loyal Kjerag warriors end the way he did...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Keep Arctosz from running into any trouble on his way, huh...? Looks like the Doctor got it right again.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I really should've brought Blaze with me. Out of all the elite operators who take the enemy head on, she's the only one who's got the mobility to traverse the mountainous terrain here.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: With the trains stopped, Kjerag's transportation network might as well be nonexistent...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Oh, whatever. Let's get going.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Do you have to go?

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: Yeah, my parents have already decided. There's no room for us in Kjerag anymore.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: I still don't believe it was your parents who did it, and it's definitely got nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: I believe it, though.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: I don't know if my parents really did it, and I also don't know... if I was an accomplice somehow.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Even if you were, I'd forgive you.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: No one looks up to my father more than you. I know that.

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes, remember our dream?

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Of course I remember.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: The two of us will turn Kjerag into the most powerful country in the world.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: But you're leaving...

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: Yeah. My parents are thinking of moving to Victoria, and I'll go to school there.

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: This is a good opportunity. I'll study all the advanced stuff there, and once I am done, I'll come back and help you.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Heh... You jerk.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: In that case, I'll let you in on this idea that I have. I haven't told anyone about this yet.

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: I'm going to leave Kjerag once both Enya and Ensia have grown up.

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: Like you, I'll study lots of things and come back.

steps.name: Boy Gnosis
steps.text: You're the future clan leader... Can you really leave Kjerag that long?

steps.name: Boy Enciodes
steps.text: I'll come find you when that happens.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Hey, Gnosis. Here's your food.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Tsk, don't think you're getting out of this mess just because you're keeping quiet.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Let me tell you. Every last person in the Silverash clan wants to skin you alive right now.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: How dare you do what you did to Sir Enciodes and the Saintess? If it wasn't for his orders to keep you locked up here, I wouldn't give you even a sip of water, let alone food.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Not going to eat, drink, or even make a peep, huh?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Alright, then. You can rot here and die for all I care!

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis, you've changed quite a lot.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: You never used to sneer at people, much less belittle them as worthless.

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: I could tell you the same.

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: You would never use your status as a weapon, and you never thought much of social pleasantries.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: It was something I had to learn to deal with the nobles.

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: And I couldn't care less how others see me if it means I can better focus on my research.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: What kind of research are you working on?

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: Life science as well as Originium analysis.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: Sounds complicated.

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: What about you? Surely you must already have a certain standing among the nobles here.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: Do you remember what we said to each other when you left Kjerag?

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: I'm very glad that I left Kjerag, Gnosis.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: It wasn't until I came to the outside world that I realized we no longer live in times where isolation is enough to keep ourselves out of the affairs around us.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: In the past hundred years, there have been countless exchanges and conflicts between nations. Columbia rose quickly in a conflict, while Gaul, a powerful country, was also wiped out in a conflict.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: All the world's nations are slowly changing in these times separated by Catastrophes. Refusing relations with others is no longer an option.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: If Kjerag remains as it is, keeping its borders closed under the assumption that will earn us a life of peace and tranquility.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: Then only destruction awaits us.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: We've reached the end of this peace and tranquility. We can't wait for anyone to throw open these gates for us. Kjerag must make contact with the outside world. We must take that step forward while we still have control.

steps.name: Young Enciodes
steps.text: Come help me, Gnosis.

steps.name: Young Gnosis
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: *Sigh*, this sucks balls.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: Stop complaining. You're starting to make me feel that way too.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: I really don't get it. Why is Sir Enciodes only locking up Gnosis?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: If I were him, I'd separate the traitor's head from his neck straight away.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: What do you know? How is beheading him going to calm Sir Enciodes's anger?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: He treated Gnosis so well, only to be betrayed.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: If I were him, I'd torture this guy some.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: You have a point, but aren't we about to go to war with the other two clans? I want to be on the front lines.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: Look at you, all bloodthirsty.

steps.name: Kjerag Warriors A & B
steps.text: Master.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How is Gnosis doing?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: He's fasted for a full day, sir.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: He hasn't said a word since we put him in there. Didn't even respond when we shouted at him.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let me talk to him.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Hey, what do you think Sir Enciodes is going to talk about?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: How would I know?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior A
steps.text: Didn't Gnosis used to be a trusted confidant? I'm betting Sir Enciodes is going to poison him. Give him a honorable death.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: You've been reading too many novels.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior B
steps.text: That said...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It seems Ratatos is seeking the Great Elder's help.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Both you and I knew this would happen sooner or later.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They can't possibly believe everything you have done is in the name of Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Most of the company's employees know that it is Karlan Trade they're working for, not Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A war is not something you start when you have a choice. I hope you can understand my hand was forced.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Perhaps you're worrying too much.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Bring down the other two families and rebuild. It's much easier than the 'honorable' solution you're pursuing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag would never truly accept me if I seized power by force.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In that case, let me do it.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I have far less worries than you do.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Let you do... what?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You can drop the act, Enciodes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: This idea has crossed your mind. We both know that.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Let me, the son of a sinner, the villain of Karlan Trade, be a traitor again. There is no one more suitable for the job.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm not your pawn, Enciodes, and I most definitely am not your underling.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm your partner-in-crime.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Even if you don't agree to it, I'll still do this.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Actually, it'll be for the better if you don't. Our charade will be that much more realistic.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Kjerag has no room for me. Truth be told, I couldn't care less whether it had any room for me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It'll just be another item on my list of charges. I don't care.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm thinking that you actually haven't changed much over the last twenty years.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And why is that?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You're a conceited perfectionist.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You always want the perfect result, and you always think that you can get it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The perfect result would be if Arctosz and Ratatos had not been in our way.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Great Elder would also have accepted the change that Kjerag is about to go through, and everything would naturally have unfolded the way we wanted.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That isn't the perfect result. You know that. At most, it's the perfect dream.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: They can't see what you and I can see. In that case, you should never have expected them to share the same ideas as us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But you and I think drastically differently as well.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I told you, Enciodes. I'm not your pawn, and I'm not your underling.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I have my own judgment, and our judgments share many overlapping points.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Or would you like to finish me, the traitor, and make this farce real?
Under the dim light, Enciodes reaches his hand out to Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm just glad that you are my dearest friend.
Gnosis keeps silent for a moment. Then, he reaches out to shake Enciodes's hand.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I told you. It'll just be another item on my list of charges. I'm more than used to that.
Nothing has changed from all those years ago.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz is amassing his forces.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What about Ratatos?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Take a look at this.

a.text:
Dear Enciodes,
The Browntails and Silverashes have long enjoyed an amiable relationship. Although we have had our differences in recent years, they are merely the natural result of our differing views on Kjerag's future.

With Kjerag's future having never looked so bright, it is now clear to me that the Silverashes have come to represent the aspirations of the masses.
With the transfer of powers in place, to prevent any unnecessary disputes and to uphold Kjerag's peace—
I, Ratatos, would like to pledge the Browntails' allegiance to the Silverashes.

I would like to meet with you on this matter, if you would be so kind as to set aside our differences.
In addition, I would also like to talk to you about the truth behind your parents' passing.
Yours, Ratatos

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: An obvious trap...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's worth going, nonetheless.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The situation is not so optimistic that you can take meaningless risks.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We've won, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We've achieved our original goal. Now, the Paleroches and the Browntails are traitors to Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My spies inside the Browntail family will help us with the public opinion. As for the Paleroches, they may be stubborn, but they are all upstanding people.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Once they wrap their minds around the gravity of Arctosz's crime, much of the Paleroches' doors will open to us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We have ample time to sort out what comes next.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Arctosz and Ratatos will not give up so easily.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is exactly why I will meet her.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If Ratatos had come with me to Victoria to study all those years ago, she would not be so much weaker than I am.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And now she has put her chips on the table, just like that. It would be untactful of me to not call this bet.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You will one day die of your arrogance, Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Then so be it, but that won't happen today or during this outing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As for Arctosz, he's not entirely without surprises, and that is why I am having you step up now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What can a hot-headed moron like him accomplish?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz himself can't, though Dr. {@nickname} certainly surprised me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: That is the greatest variable in this game of ours, and it's one that I have to watch out for.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I agree that one has done many things beyond my expectation since arriving in Kjerag, but is this Doctor really worthy of your concern?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: One who knows almost nothing about Kjerag has stepped into one of the stage's most vital roles within such a short period of time, greatly disrupting our plans.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I can honestly say that if I were in that position, I would not have been able to do it.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And I also cannot begin to imagine what the Doctor is planning to do next. Perhaps the Doctor won't do a thing, or perhaps—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Doctor can do something that I couldn't begin to imagine.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hmph, this isn't my first time telling you this—If you're afraid to lose, you better not act like you're enjoying the challenge.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You've fooled many, but you cannot fool me. You cannot fool the bodyguard you hired from Kazimierz either.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Likewise, this isn't my first time to offer you this rebuttal. Taking delight in a gamble and not wanting to lose are not mutually exclusive.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Much of the joy one derives from a gamble comes not from the result. Rather, it comes from the whole march towards victory.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Fine, say no more. This is always the hardest part for us to reach a consensus. I only wish that I still have a chance to save you before your arrogance ends up killing you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We will have many opportunities to debate this later. In any case, I will leave you in charge while I meet with Ratatos.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Is there anyone left in Karlan Trade who would listen to me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Weiss, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The two of them will pass on any of your orders.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Gnosis, Sir Enciodes has told us everything. We owe you much.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I never thought it could all be a ruse...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Let's save the pleasantries.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Tsk, and here I thought I could finally get some quiet time.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: My research has been halted for far too long already. At least I could read some books if you'd kept me locked in here.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You're my partner-in-crime, and this undertaking is ours together. You will have more than enough time to do your research in the future.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: That's only if you make it back here alive...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's time to go, Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm leaving everything in your hands, Gnosis.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm curious. Back at the ceremony, were you going at it for real?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What if I was?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Then perhaps you need to spend some time to work on your skills.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You looked worse than before.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I needn't you worry.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: My impression is that you could make half an enemy of mine. I have to worry, lest life get a bit too boring.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Caster is only a side job to me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Your acting could be that much better too, if you were a little stronger.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That said, I've never seen you even a little excited.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Convincing performance.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Not that you're acting.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Gnosis, what should we...?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Where's Monch?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Monch is being held in another room. I can take you there.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Does she know?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir Enciodes said it'd be best for you to tell her yourself.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Lead the way.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir Gnosis...
Monch takes out a dagger from her boot. It is her most prized weapon.
It is a gift that Gnosis made for her between his experiments.
She lightly strokes the dagger, her eyes clouded with doubt and uncertainty.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid, Monch.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: It looks like you're well...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Thank goodness.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You've done a great job.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I... I promised you.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Whatever your orders, your wish is my command...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Judging by your look, I assume you've figured it all out.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Right, Enciodes and I had all of this planned in advance.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I see, so that's really how it is...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: The Silverashes' Weiss was waiting below the cliff to rescue me, and I've been wondering ever since.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: If this was all a charade planned in advance, then what role do I play in it?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: And now that I find you here, I'm finally sure...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: My apologies.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You needn't ever apologize to me...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Monch, you stand firm in your beliefs. I understand, but I will judge for myself what I say.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes and I had a rift, leading me to leave Karlan Trade and make contact with Ratatos. That was our plan all along.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: And the fewer people who knew of this plan, the better. That's why I never told you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Both of us knew the risks.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I had to make sure even the finest details were under our control. Everything had to be absolutely perfect. This isn't one of my usual maneuvers... There is no do-over.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If that displeases you in any way, I must apologize.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: No... T-That's not it...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Why...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: It doesn't matter what it is you want to do or what plans you have. I...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: ...I will always support you.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Why didn't you believe me?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: You could've trusted me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Monch, I hope you can understand.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's because I fully trust you that I handed you such an important task under those circumstances.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I trust you, my finest subordinate, to perfectly execute my plans.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Don't overthink it. You've done very well, and everything is over now. Try to relax a little.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You should take the time to rest.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Looks like you're not in the mood to talk...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'll come see you again.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Trust me...?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Who trusts me? And where are they...?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Sir Gnosis... Can I still trust you?
